name: Pinned Globe
description: A solid globe with shaded land and sea, and people pinned to places.

props.name: markers
props.type: { lat: number; lng: number; src?: string; label: string }[]
props.description: People or places to pin. Each shows its image in a ring, or a dot without one, and its label on hover or focus. Markers fade out as they turn to the far side. Focusing one from the keyboard turns the globe to face it.

props.name: autoRotateSpeed
props.description: Turning speed in degrees per frame at 60 frames a second. 0 stops it. It pauses while dragged, while a marker is hovered and under reduced motion.

props.name: enableZoom
props.description: Let the wheel, and the + and − keys, zoom between 0.85× and 2.2×.

props.name: initialRotation
props.description: The longitude and latitude facing the viewer at the start. Latitude is kept within 60 degrees.

props.name: onMarkerClick
props.description: Called when a marker is clicked or activated from the keyboard.

props.name: onMarkerHover
props.description: Called with the marker when the pointer enters it, and with null when it leaves.

props.name: landColor
props.default: snow by day, frost at night
props.description: Fill for the land. Shading is laid over it.

props.name: seaColor
props.default: water by day, deep water at night
props.description: Base colour for the sea, lightened toward the highlight and deepened toward the edge.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. The globe is drawn centred in it, as large as fits. Other div props are passed through.
